issue.message:
Library lint checks out of date; these checks **will be skipped**!
Lint found an issue registry (`androidx.lifecycle.lint.LifecycleRuntimeIssueRegistry`) which was compiled against an older version of lint than this one. This is usually fine, but not in this case; some basic verification shows that the lint check jar references (for example) the following API which is no longer valid in this version of lint: org.jetbrains.kotlin.asJava.elements.KtLightModifierList#getKotlinOrigin(): org.jetbrains.kotlin.psi.KtModifierList (Referenced from androidx/lifecycle/lint/LifecycleWhenChecksKt.class)
Therefore, this lint check library is **not** included in analysis. This affects the following lint checks: `UnsafeLifecycleWhenUsage`,`RepeatOnLifecycleWrongUsage`
Recompile the checks against the latest version, or if this is a check bundled with a third-party library, see if there is a more recent version available.
Version of Lint API this lint check is using is 14. The Lint API version currently running is 16 (8.7+).
Not targeting the latest versions of Android; compatibility modes apply. Consider testing and updating this version. Consult the `android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES` javadoc for details.
